why: Both properties fail the pre-registered 2x within-corpus-MAE degradation bar under the minority-to-majority macro-chemotype direction (n_macro_a=16 vs n_macro_b=1052). refractive_index: training on the small macro-chemotype and cold-predicting the bulk gives 9.92x degradation (R2=-5.00, strongly negative); the reverse direction gives 3.13x (also >2x). thermal_conductivity: direction A gives 4.52x degradation (R2=-2.83); direction B gives 1.86x. Both directions clearing the bar for refractive_index, and direction A clearing it for thermal_conductivity, is sufficient under the pre-registered OR-across-directions criterion (identical to C7 fire 2's rule) to REFUTE both properties' claim to out-of-distribution generalization. Combined with C7 (density) and C8/W2 (dielectric label inadmissibility), ALL FOUR properties in multi-target-ml-radonpy-4-properties-audit-kpi.v1.json are now shown to fail a genuinely falsifying, chemically-coherent held-out test -- the KPI's entire shipped headline is built exclusively on a non-group-safe 60/20/20 random split that does not reflect out-of-corpus predictive skill for any of its 4 targets.
